verdict.rationale: Vast.ai documents overlay networks that put instances on different machines in the same physical LAN onto a private virtual LAN. That gives direct all-port communication for NCCL multi-node training, and the whole flow is self-serve: sign up, add credit, rent via the web or CLI, with no sales cycle. However, nothing evidences a high-speed fabric such as InfiniBand or RDMA, and clusters are limited to machines sharing one physical LAN. Missing for 10: documented fast interconnect (InfiniBand/RDMA bandwidth specs), a first-class cluster provisioning workflow beyond per-instance rental plus overlay network, and independent hands-on corroboration of multi-node training performance.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can provision a multi-node GPU cluster with fast interconnect for distributed training without a sales cycle

citations.quote: Vast now supports creating *overlay* networks for instances, allowing client instances on different machines on the same physical LAN to share a private, virtual LAN
This allows direct communication between the instances on all ports, which is expected by NCCL.
Create an account on vast.ai. Verify your email address. ... Go to Billing → Add Credit and top up
